messages:
deploy-bot: Rollout kick: release=v2.9.0 slice=US-1 -> starting canary (10% traffic). change_window=2026-03-22T02:00Z-04:00Z. docs: /release/3023456789
alex: Starting smoke checks. hitting /health on canary pods and tailing logs. will report infra metrics.
jay: US warm pool: 118/200 GPUs warmed. warming jobs 22 pending. ETA ~12m.
maria: Pinning model to v2.9.0-quant for US; EU/APAC remain at v2.8.5 to avoid cross-region churn.
sre: Observability quick pass: p50=42ms, p95=180ms (baseline p95=160ms). CPU on inference nodes 72%, mem 64%. no errors > threshold yet.
ops-bot: Capacity check: predicted headroom for US-1 at planned ramp 18% (threshold 15%). EU headroom 22%, APAC headroom 6% (low).
alex: Running a small load script to emulate steady traffic spike. will post outputs if anything odd.
maria: Reminder: change window covers entire slice warmup. all rollbacks must be logged in the console and @eng-oncall paged. :loud_sound:
jay: Quick test command we used:
```
# simulate 200 concurrent lightweight requests
for i in {1..200}; do curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"sanity"}' & done
wait
```
alex: Results so far: no 5xx, tail latencies stable. small jitter around 00:15 UTC.
maria: Proposal: rollback criteria = any of: 1) canary_5xx_rate > 1.5% for 5m, 2) p95 > 500ms sustained 5m, 3) token_cost spike > 30% vs baseline for 10m. agree?
sre: Agree to criteria. will wire alerts: `canary_errors > 1.5% for 5m` and `latency_p95 > 500ms` -> notify #eng-oncall and escalate to oncall pager.
ops-bot: Preflight sanity summary: EU pool free GPUs 60, APAC free GPUs 20 (insufficient for warmbackfill). recommend holding APAC rollout until warm capacity increased.
katie: Can we provision extra reserved capacity into APAC quickly? reserved_pool=32, required_estimate=40 -> short by 8 GPUs. opening infra ticket.
jay: For transparency, we'll keep APAC pinned to v2.8.5 for now and only shift EU after US holds for 30m.
alex: Manual approval requested to increase canary to 30% for US-1. approving: alex. deploy-bot: Canary traffic increased to 30% on US-1 per manual approval by alex.
ops-bot: Throttle guard placed: if queue_length > 1500 OR in_flight_requests > 600 => auto-defer rollout and notify #eng-sre.
jay: Noted a small uptick in tail latencies at ~00:15 but within threshold. continuing to observe.
sre: No 5xx spikes yet. CPU trending steady. recommend proceed to EU canary at 30% in 30m if no regression.
maria: I'll update release notes: pinned_regions=[APAC], canary_regions=[US,EU], release_notes_url=https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.9.0/notes
ops-bot: Snapshotting capacity metrics: snapshot_id=cap-3023456789-1 saved.
deploy-bot: Rollout log: deploy_id=3023456789-branch/main recorded. steps: canary-start -> metrics-monitor -> manual-increase.
jay: Quick playbook link for anyone joining later -> https://redwood.internal/playbooks/rollouts#zonal-cutover (bookmark)
katie: Filed infra ticket #INC-1145 to request APAC warm pool expansion. assigning to @infra-team.
alex: Good run so far. holding steady for +30m then reconvene for EU decision. tagging @maria @katie @sre for post-checks.
maria: Copy. prepping pinned release note and console tags. will add rollback rationale and metrics snapshot.
ops-bot: If any auto-defer triggers, we'll record `defer_reason` in the rollout audit and create follow-up snippet.
alex: Thanks all — will post an interim update at +15m and final go/no-go at +30m.
